items.title: United Airlines bans AI agents from booking flights on behalf of travelers
items.summary: Using an artificial intelligence agent to make flight reservations poses security risks and could violate federal rules, according to United.
items.titleZh: 联合航空禁止 AI 代理代旅客预订航班
items.summaryZh: 联合航空称，使用人工智能代理预订航班存在安全风险，也可能违反联邦规定。

items.title: My AI agents found an unmapped Maya site?
items.summary: AI agents analyzed public lidar data overnight and found a Maya site under the jungle. It turned out archaeologists had mapped it already, but it wasn't in Mexico's official register yet.
items.titleZh: 我的 AI 代理发现了一处未标注的玛雅遗址？
items.summaryZh: AI 代理夜间分析公开的激光雷达数据，在丛林下发现一处玛雅遗址。后来发现，考古学家早已绘制了该遗址的地图，但它尚未列入墨西哥官方名录。

items.title: Nvidia is preparing to oust Jensen Huang
items.titleZh: 英伟达正准备罢免黄仁勋

items.title: AWS emulator
items.summary: AWS Emulator is a local emulator of the AWS APIs. Contribute to aws/aws-emulator development by creating an account on GitHub.
items.summaryZh: AWS 模拟器是一个用于模拟 AWS API 的本地工具。你可以在 GitHub 上创建账户，为 aws/aws-emulator 项目贡献代码。

items.title: Jensen Huang said to have had relationship with executive who reports to him
items.titleZh: 据称黄仁勋曾与向他汇报的高管有过一段关系

items.title: A false smoke alarm almost drowned Jane Street's only NYC datacenter
items.summary: A war story from Jane Street’s systems team: a false smoke alarm, a datacenter with no cooling, and a sprint to pull every power cord before the sprinklers went off
items.titleZh: 误报烟雾警报险些淹没 Jane Street 在纽约市唯一的数据中心
items.summaryZh: Jane Street 系统团队的一段惊险经历：烟雾警报误报、数据中心失去制冷，以及在洒水系统启动前拔掉所有电源线的紧急行动。

items.title: Gemini Decisions API
items.summary: The Gemini Decisions API provides fast, calibrated multimodal decisions for Google apps. Evaluate 1,000 questions in one pass. Get the details.
items.summaryZh: Gemini Decisions API 可为 Google 应用快速提供经过校准的多模态决策。一次即可评估 1,000 个问题。了解详情。

items.title: Tim Peters has died
items.summary: I am immensely sad to announce that Tim Peters has died earlier this year on July 15. It’s hard to overestimate Tim’s influence on Python. He’s probably best known for writing the Zen of Python (PEP 20), but to me he wa…
items.summaryZh: 我无比悲痛地宣布，Tim Peters 于今年 7 月 15 日去世。Tim 对 Python 的影响怎么评价都不为过。他最为人熟知的贡献或许是撰写了《Python 之禅》（PEP 20），但对我来说，他……

items.title: Who could replace Jensen Huang? A highly unscientific list of possible successors
items.summary: Nvidia has no succession plan and a CEO in hot water, so we’ve drafted a shortlist.
items.titleZh: 谁能接替黄仁勋？一份极不科学的潜在继任者名单
items.summaryZh: 英伟达没有继任计划，首席执行官也正陷入风波，因此我们拟出了一份候选人短名单。

items.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
items.summary: The affair could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.
items.titleZh: 黄仁勋风波持续发酵：事件时间线
items.summaryZh: 这段关系可能影响国家安全；美国和中国正竞相开发最先进的 AI 基础设施。

items.title: Nvidia’s stock drops as board reportedly preps to oust CEO Jensen Huang
items.summary: As soon as Wednesday evening, Nvidia's board could decide to remove its founder and CEO of 33 years.
items.titleZh: 据报道，英伟达董事会准备罢免黄仁勋，公司股价下跌
items.summaryZh: 最快到周三晚间，英伟达董事会就可能决定解除这位创始人兼任职 33 年的首席执行官的职务。

items.title: Jensen Huang accused of having another affair — with an Nvidia exec
items.summary: Jensen Huang, who has come under fire for admitting to an affair with a woman accused of being a Chinese intelligence agent, has been accused of having a separate affair with an Nvidia subordinate.
items.titleZh: 黄仁勋被指另有一段关系，对象是英伟达高管
items.summaryZh: 黄仁勋此前承认与一名被指为中国情报人员的女性有染，因而受到抨击；如今他又被指与另一名英伟达下属有染。

items.title: Why the data center you dread might never even be built
items.summary: The data center boom is running into serious real-world obstacles, from widespread local opposition and permitting delays to a scramble for electricity. Before those challenges even come into play, though, there’s a more…
items.titleZh: 你担心的数据中心或许根本建不起来
items.summaryZh: 数据中心热潮正遭遇严峻的现实阻碍，包括当地普遍反对、审批延误以及电力争夺。不过，在这些挑战真正显现之前，还有一个更……

items.title: Meta is losing its longtime head of infrastructure
items.summary: Santosh Janardhan, who originally joined the company in 2009, will be stepping down from his role.
items.titleZh: Meta 将失去长期担任基础设施主管的高管
items.summaryZh: Santosh Janardhan 于 2009 年加入公司，现将卸任其职务。

items.title: CoreWeave turns to customer prepayments, shorter contracts to fund AI growth
items.summary: CoreWeave is increasingly asking customers to pay up front, borrowing against specific contracts, and even looking to short-term deals that could lead to higher prices, according to the company’s third-quarter earnings.
items.titleZh: CoreWeave 转向客户预付款和短期合同，为 AI 增长融资
items.summaryZh: 根据公司第三季度财报，CoreWeave 越来越多地要求客户预付款，以特定合同为担保借款，甚至考虑可能推高价格的短期交易。

items.title: With $720M round, Britain’s Fractile gets a leg up in the race for AI chips
items.summary: Fractile has now become one of the top-funded players in the race for purpose-built AI chips.
items.titleZh: 获 7.2 亿美元融资，英国 Fractile 在 AI 芯片竞赛中取得优势
items.summaryZh: Fractile 已成为专用 AI 芯片竞赛中融资额最高的参与者之一。
